lines.text: Meet CD. The fastest way to move a file.
Just drag it in, drop it, and you get five digits.
On the other device, type the code, and hit Connect.
Boom. It streams straight across, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing uploaded, nothing stored.
Living in the terminal? Run C D X send. Same code.
Punch it into any browser, hit Connect, and watch it fly. Done. Every byte, verified.
CD. Try it now, at CD dot yash zero dot in.
